sources.title: Gujarat statewide layer; 3,401 polygons fall in the Surat district box
sources.publisher: Space Applications Centre (ISRO), National Wetland Atlas hydrological layer
sources.license: Government of India publication, cited with attribution

provenance.note: SAC National Wetland Atlas hydrological layer for Gujarat, clipped to a Surat district bounding box; complete placemarks only, because the source download was interrupted mid-record. 3401 polygons in the district box, 1434 inside city limits. THIN SEMANTICS: only 34 carry a name, and the source's level_iii and l4type classification fields are empty for every Surat feature, so category is limited to Inland/Coastal and Man-made/Natural.
